_about: Daily visits at the Spring (gd1). 'lines': id -> text (blank line = new box; <name> = the farmer). Ids starting with B / 0 are already approved in batch 1 / batch 2 and are only referenced here; D / G / R are new drafts for the user to edit. 'rules' says when each line is used.

rules.first_ever: B1  - the first time you call her after the summoning
rules.greet: first talk of the day: rain/storm B7; 5:00-8:59 B4; 17:00-19:59 B5; 20:00-4:59 B6; otherwise B3 (0-1 hearts) or B2 / B8 / B9 in turn
rules.chat: later talks the same day: her season line (0C9/0CB spring, 0CC/0CF summer, 0D0/0D1 autumn, 0D4/0D5 winter) or a hearts line (D1-D4 under 3 hearts, D5-D8 from 3 hearts), alternating
rules.too_much: R1 - after the 5th talk in a day
rules.gift_offering: G1 - one of the 15 offering items (loved): +4
rules.gift_fish: B14b the first fish ever, then 060 (loved): +4
rules.gift_again: G3 - a second gift the same day (she keeps it; no change)
rules.affection: first talk of the day +1; hearts like Celia / Muffy / Nami: love 20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 90 = 1-5 red (under 10 one grey, 10-19 one green); 0 at the summoning

lines.D1:
The water's so calm
today. You should
sit and rest a bit.
lines.D2:
Don't just stand
there. Tell me
something fun!
lines.D3:
I've been asleep for
so long... The valley
looks so different.
lines.D4:
A princess needs
visitors, you know.
Come by more often.
lines.D5:
I was hoping you'd
come. ...Don't let
it go to your head.
lines.D6:
You always look so
serious. Smile for
me, <name>!
lines.D7:
When you're here,
the spring feels
warmer.
lines.D8:
Stay a little
longer? Just a
little.
lines.R1:
Again? You really
can't stay away from
me, can you?
lines.G1:
Oh! Just like the
old offerings...

You remembered.
Thank you, <name>.
lines.G2:
...What is this?

You don't give
rubbish to a
princess!
lines.G3:
Another gift? I'll
take it, of course.

But one a day is
plenty, you know.
